Original redistributable text/two-part miniatures admitted by separate reviewer. 14 integrity tests pass; three compiled guard-deletion mutants discriminate a bad replay from the accepting control.

First attempt was refused for graph/text checksum conflation; both identities now retained, failed attempt preserved, accepted runs repeated at corrected SHA. Word coverage retains 94 consumed conjunction separators outside unit spans explicitly. No gold or sealed outcomes read; raw artifacts remain ignored. No accuracy, calibration, behavioral-recovery or media-reachability claim. S0, fail-closed scorer, and production ClockRepair integration remain separate tickets.
